items.title: Meta / Facebook | app access to terminal photo gallery
items.summary: The Garante found that the Facebook Android app accessed users’ photos, videos and metadata for gallery suggestions without specific, informed consent for that function. · ePrivacy 罚款 €805,000,000

items.title: FNAC Darty | mobile-app terminal-identifier tracking
items.summary: The CNIL found that the mobile app sent an FNAC-assigned identifier and browsing activity to a third-party domain for personalisation and recommendation-model training without consent. · ePrivacy 罚款 €

items.title: Google | cookies and Gmail advertising emails
items.summary: The CNIL found that Google displayed advertising between private Gmail messages without prior consent and obtained invalid consent for advertising cookies during account creation. · ePrivacy 罚款 €325,0

items.title: SOLOCAL MARKETING SERVICES | data brokerage and electronic marketing
items.summary: SOLOCAL used prospect data obtained through data brokers and contest/testing forms to run SMS or email prospecting for advertisers.

items.title: Brown Thomas | opt-out mechanism and marketing email
items.summary: Brown Thomas pleaded guilty to five sample charges out of 21, involving missing opt-out addresses and continued marketing after consent withdrawal.

items.title: American Express | cookie withdrawal and refusal
items.summary: The CNIL found that American Express placed cookies before a choice, ignored refusal, and continued reading cookies after withdrawal. · ePrivacy 罚款 €1,500,000

items.title: LES PUBLICATIONS CONDE NAST | Vanity Fair cookies
items.summary: The CNIL found that vanityfair.fr placed consent-based cookies before banner interaction and continued reading them after refusal or withdrawal. · ePrivacy 罚款 €750,000

items.title: Orange | inbox advertising and cookie withdrawal
items.summary: The CNIL found that Orange inserted advertising in inboxes without consent and continued reading cookies after users withdrew consent. · ePrivacy 罚款 €50,000,000
